# Composer mode bar — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the composer mode bar when the message needs a visibility — public, internal, or note — and the choice must read as one choice rather than three buttons. It is a radiogroup named by `label`, Message visibility by default, over exactly three modes: there is no `options` prop, and a fourth visibility would be a product decision rather than a prop. The trio is fixed so that every composer labels it the same way, and the checked mode paints with the secondary-container treatment, so the painted and announced modes agree. `mode`, `defaultMode` and `onModeChange` make it controlled or uncontrolled, and it is exported on its own because hosts place it outside the composer too.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the composer mode bar when the message needs a visibility — public, internal, or note — and the choice must read as one choice rather than three buttons. It is a radiogroup named by `label` with Public, Internal and Note as its three radio options over exactly three modes: there is no `options` prop, and a fourth visibility would be a product decision rather than a prop. The checked mode paints with the secondary-container treatment, so the painted and announced modes agree, and `mode`, `defaultMode` and `onModeChange` make it controlled or uncontrolled. It is exported on its own because hosts place it outside the composer too, and choosing is a press on options that carry radio roles in one radiogroup.
